extraction.notes: Whole document read (108 pages). Chapter 2 (pages 25-30) extracted in full: country presentation parts as North Macedonia's reported view, Commission assessment and summary-of-findings parts as the Commission. Other chapters (1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 28) were screened for technology material; only material passages were extracted, doubtful ones flagged theme_doubtful. Not extracted as incidental or not material: radio equipment and electromagnetic compatibility product rules, the electronic communications agency's radiation measurements, payment services and SEPA, national medicine registers published on a website, the SEI-NET website link for management reports, shareholder rights 'technical adaptations', semiconductor topographies, the Central Registry electronic archive date, the rare diseases register plan, the registry of direct investments. Standard Commission wording ('good level of preparation', 'early stage') appears only for Chapter 2 sub-areas and is recorded in eu_scale with applies_to sub_area; no standard progress wording is used. period_covered is empty in the source register and the report does not state one. Quotes crossing a page break set page_end and leave out the printed page number. items.stated_text: Although national legislation is not aligned with the EU acquis on eHealth, North Macedonia has a centralised eHealth tool that creates and stores health data and health information, including real-time data on patients, doctors, health services, health records, referrals, prescriptions, screening results, risk factor s, allergies and intolerances, adverse effects, telemedicine, dental records, and certificates.
